description.value: A 320-hectare BC Parks campground on the shores of Charlie Lake, 13 km northwest of Fort St. John, with a sandy swimming beach, walleye and pike fishing, hiking trails, and groomed cross-country ski trails in winter; the gate closes during the off-season so confirm dates before arrival.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Beatton Park is an active provincial campground on Charlie Lake with 39 sites (corroborated by OSM capacity tag). Cycling is explicitly allowed ('Cycling is allowed in the park. Bicycles must keep to roadways.'). Reservations are confirmed via BC Parks frontcountry camping system ('Book camping' links throughout). OSM tag internet_access=no aligns with the rural/provincial park setting. No evidence on the page for showers, potable water, hiker/biker sites, food, or other amenities beyond what's listed.
concerns: OSM email (sandstormnorth@gmail.com) belongs to the park operator (Sandstorm North Contracting), not BC Parks — may change if operator contract changes
Park is 13 km off Highway 97 via the 244 road — not directly on the highway, which touring cyclists should know
No direct campground phone number found; BC Parks general line is 1-800-689-9025
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground that explicitly permits cycling, located along the Highway 97 corridor in Northern BC. Useful stop for touring cyclists in the Peace region.

wow_evidence: Cycling is allowed in the park. Bicycles must keep to roadways.
